compositionDeltasVsSourceRun.candidate: cf29eea8 -> da88e7a2 (see candidateDeltaAudit). This is the only intentional candidate change.
compositionDeltasVsSourceRun.concurrency: fh_max_parallel 8 -> 3. The previous full run lost three datacurve cells to a public.ecr.aws manifest throttle (429 toomanyrequests) with eight concurrent Docker image builds, and the same throttle cost one of three cells in the recovery batch that ran at five; it has never been reproduced at one. Three is chosen as the smallest width that still bounds the run's wall clock, so that this batch has a real chance of producing the failed run's missing verdicts rather than repeating its infrastructure loss. It is a composition delta on purpose and is recorded here so the run is never read as byte-identical to 36711152110.
compositionDeltasVsSourceRun.hostContention: A GitHub-hosted runner has four CPUs and this harness never cpus-limits a task container, so fewer concurrent containers also means less CPU contention inside them; this matters for the corpus's timing-sensitive cells (terminal-bench/largest-eigenval measures a speedup, and terminal-bench/polyglot-c-py is another performance cell).
compositionDeltasVsSourceRun.budgets: fh_agent_timeout_multiplier=1 and the frozen per-task budgets are unchanged (5400 s for the nine datacurve cells, each task's own timeout for the twenty-one terminal-bench cells). The per-call ceiling stays generation.modelInvocationTimeoutMs = 1800000 ms and the attempt-delivery reserve stays 180,000 ms by design (spec 271 corrected only the delivery output bound).
compositionDeltasVsSourceRun.provider: Unchanged: deepseek-v4.1-flash at reasoning effort max, compatible, dim-oauth, https://dimagent.cn/v1.
compositionDeltasVsSourceRun.harnessEnvironmentFix: Both task-environment plugins now write a git identity before the attempt (see relationshipToEarlierWork.environmentFixInThisBatch). This batch is the first full run whose attempts start with a usable git identity; any commit in this run's evidence should carry the harness host's identity rather than being refused.
compositionDeltasVsSourceRun.executionProfile: Unchanged: plain workspace backend, unrestricted authorization, host process isolation, release close policy, path command policy, read/write/exec grants, tools excluded: network.

knownRisks.ecrThrottle: Three concurrent image builds is below every width at which the throttle was observed, but a throttle caused by other tenants on the shared public.ecr.aws quota cannot be excluded; if it recurs the affected cell again has no model attempt and nothing is retried inside this run.
knownRisks.specificationGaps: Three corpus tasks carry a declared specification gap (httpx-multipart-response-parsing, fastapi-deprecation-response-headers, meriyah-explicit-resource-declarations). Their verdicts are real but cannot be read as capability, and the aggregate excludes them from capability comparisons.
knownRisks.timingCells: terminal-bench/largest-eigenval and terminal-bench/polyglot-c-py measure performance and are sensitive to host load; they are read as measured, at this batch's own concurrency, and never compared across batches with a different width.
knownRisks.budget: Thirty attempts over three concurrent slots: the nine datacurve cells carry a 5400 s budget each, so the batch is expected to take roughly three hours and the two terminal-bench delivery cells still stop their primary Run at budget minus the 180 s reserve by design.
knownRisks.credentialExpiry: BENCHMARK_PROVIDER_API_KEY is the rotating dim OAuth JWT; the earlier batches recorded an expiry five days out from 2026-09-30. Every Generate job verifies the credential at materialization before any attempt.
knownRisks.unpushedLocalCommit: The dispatching checkout's main carries one unpushed commit on top of the pin (3b786c9d 'chore: update deps'). It is deliberately not part of the candidate: CI can only check out a pushed commit, and a dependency bump is not a benchmark-visible change this batch is meant to measure. If that commit is later pushed, a run on it would be a new candidate and a new batch.

constraints: Exactly one predeclared headless attempt per corpus task, all thirty tasks, nothing else.

Every earlier verdict stands as measured on its own candidate; this batch replaces, repairs and reinterprets nothing.
The official agent and verifier budgets are preserved (fh_agent_timeout_multiplier=1) and never extended.
Nothing is published to main and no other run is cancelled, restarted or re-dispatched.
